title: CopilotResponse
description: A structured recommendation bundle produced by the TrafficCopilot AI engine in response to an active incident. Contains the incident summary, ranked action recommendations, drafted public alerts, and supporting evidence.

recommendation_id.description: Unique identifier for this recommendation bundle (UUID v4).

incident_id.description: Foreign key to the Incident record this recommendation was generated for.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this recommendation was produced.

model_version.description: Identifier of the LLM model and prompt version used (e.g. llama-3.3-70b-versatile@v2.1).

actions.description: Ordered list of recommended actions, highest priority first.

alerts.description: Drafted public alert messages ready for operator review and approval.

sop_references.description: SOP document chunks retrieved via RAG that informed this recommendation.

routing_alternatives.description: Alternative route options calculated by the routing module.

signal_plan.description: Recommended signal retiming plan, if applicable.

confidence.description: Overall confidence score for this recommendation bundle (0.0–1.0).

status.description: Approval lifecycle status of this recommendation.

approved_by.description: Officer ID or username who approved or rejected this recommendation.

approved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the approval decision was recorded.

approval_notes.description: Free-text notes added by the approving officer.

fallback_mode.description: True if this recommendation was generated using the fallback rule-based engine rather than the LLM (e.g. due to LLM API unavailability).

latency_ms.description: End-to-end generation latency in milliseconds from incident trigger to recommendation ready.

IncidentSummary.title: IncidentSummary
IncidentSummary.description: AI-generated structured summary of the incident derived from all ingested signals.

description.description: Human-readable incident summary generated by the LLM.

affected_lanes.description: Number of lanes confirmed or estimated to be affected.

total_lanes.description: Total number of lanes on the affected road at this location.

estimated_delay_min.description: Estimated delay for through-traffic in minutes.

queue_length_km.description: Estimated queue length in kilometres upstream of incident.

estimated_clearance_time.description: Estimated ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the incident is expected to be cleared.

injuries_confirmed.description: Whether injuries have been confirmed by field units or CAD.

emergency_services_on_scene.description: Whether emergency services have been confirmed on scene.

confidence_sources.description: Data sources that contributed to this summary.

RecommendedAction.title: RecommendedAction
RecommendedAction.description: A single discrete action recommended for the operator to take.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for this action within the recommendation bundle.

priority.description: Priority rank (1 = highest priority, take immediately).

description.description: Short operator-facing description of what to do.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this action is recommended, grounded in SOP and observed data.

sop_aligned.description: Whether this action is aligned with a retrieved SOP document.

sop_id.description: Identifier of the SOP that authorises or recommends this action (e.g. SOP-001).

target_resource.description: The specific resource this action targets (e.g. VMS board ID, signal intersection ID, ramp ID).

deadline_minutes.description: Time within which this action should be taken to meet SOP compliance (minutes from recommendation generation).

approved.description: Whether this specific action has been individually approved by an operator.

approved_by.description: Officer who approved this specific action.

DraftAlert.title: DraftAlert
DraftAlert.description: A draft public alert message generated for a specific channel, awaiting operator approval before dispatch.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier for this draft alert.

message_text.description: Fully rendered alert message text, ready for publication.

template_id.description: ID of the alert template used to generate this message.

character_count.description: Character count of message_text (for VMS and social media channel limits).

approved_by.description: Officer who approved this alert for sending.

sent_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the alert was actually dispatched.

SOPReference.title: SOPReference
SOPReference.description: A reference to a Standard Operating Procedure chunk retrieved via RAG.

chunk_id.description: Unique identifier of the specific chunk within the SOP document.

relevance_score.description: Cosine similarity score from pgvector retrieval.

excerpt.description: The specific text excerpt from the SOP that was retrieved.

RoutingAlternative.title: RoutingAlternative
RoutingAlternative.description: An alternative route calculated by the OSM routing module.

route_id.description: Unique identifier for this alternative route.

description.description: Human-readable description of the alternative route (e.g. 'Via Highway 101 N to Exit 38').

waypoints.description: Ordered list of waypoints defining the alternative route geometry.

estimated_travel_time_min.description: Estimated travel time via this alternative in minutes.

distance_km.description: Total distance of the alternative route in kilometres.

extra_distance_km.description: Additional distance compared to the primary route (can be negative if primary route is detoured).

capacity_rating.description: Current Level of Service rating of the alternative route.

recommended.description: Whether this is the AI's top recommended alternative.

SignalPlanRecommendation.title: SignalPlanRecommendation
SignalPlanRecommendation.description: Recommended emergency signal timing adjustments for one or more intersections.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for this signal plan recommendation.

current_cycle_sec.description: Current signal cycle length in seconds.

recommended_cycle_sec.description: Recommended signal cycle length in seconds.

green_extension_sec.description: Number of seconds to extend the green phase on the critical approach.

critical_approach.description: The approach direction requiring priority (e.g. northbound).

rationale.description: Explanation of why these signal changes are recommended.

sop_reference.description: SOP document authorising these changes (e.g. SOP-004).

revert_after_minutes.description: Recommended time after which base timing plans should be restored.

approval_tier.description: SOP-004 approval tier required for this plan.
